items.title: Carlsberg India Updates IPO Papers as Company Prepares for Stock Market Debut
items.snippet: Carlsberg India has submitted a revised draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) to the capital markets regulator SEBI for its proposed IPO, which will include an offer of sale of up to 8.64 crore shares by promoter South Asian Breweries. The public offering does not involve any new issuing of shares.

items.title: Centre Approves INR 10,000 Crore Scheme to Strengthen India’s Container Manufacturing Industry
items.snippet: The Union Cabinet approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS) with a financial outlay of INR 10,000 cr to boost the container manufacturing industry in India up to FY 2039-40. The plan intends to increase the domestic production capacity to 7.5 lakh TEUs per annum.
